name: NSF 22-586 CAREER
source: NSF 22-586 — Faculty Early Career Development Program (CAREER)

rules.title_vi: Tổ chức nộp hồ sơ hợp lệ
rules.quote: Proposals may only be submitted by: Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs) - Two- and four-year IHEs (including community colleges) accredited in, and having a campus located in the US; or Non-profit, non-academic organizations: Independent museums, observatories, research labs, professional societies and similar organizations in the U.S.

rules.title_vi: PI có bằng tiến sĩ trong lĩnh vực NSF hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Hold a doctoral degree in a field supported by NSF

rules.title_vi: PI đang nghiên cứu trong lĩnh vực NSF hỗ trợ
rules.quote: Be engaged in research in an area of science, engineering, or education supported by NSF

rules.title_vi: Vị trí tenure-track ≥50%, chức danh Assistant Professor
rules.quote: Hold at least a 50% tenure-track (or tenure-track-equivalent) position as an assistant professor (or equivalent title). Faculty members who are Associate Professors or in equivalent appointments, with or without tenure, are not eligible.
Have not previously received a CAREER award. (Prior or concurrent Federal support for other types of awards for non-duplicative research does not preclude eligibility.)

rules.title_vi: Giới hạn số lần dự thi (1/năm, tối đa 3 lần)
rules.quote: A Principal Investigator (PI) may submit only one CAREER proposal per annual competition. In addition, a Principal Investigator may not participate in more than three CAREER competitions.
No co-PIs are permitted. Proposals that are non-compliant: Co-principal investigator(s) listed on the cover page will be returned without review.

rules.title_vi: Có thư của trưởng khoa (Departmental Letter), ≤2 trang
rules.quote: The proposal must include one (and only one) letter from the PI's department head (or equivalent organizational official). The Departmental Letter should be no more than 2 pages in length. A proposal submitted without this Letter will be returned without review.

rules.title_vi: Thuyết minh ≤15 trang, tích hợp nghiên cứu + giáo dục
rules.quote: The Project Description may not exceed 15 pages. The Project Description should include: a description of the proposed research project; a description of the proposed educational activities; a description of how the research and educational activities are integrated or synergistic.

rules.title_vi: Ngân sách tối thiểu $400,000/5 năm ($500,000 với BIO/ENG/OPP)
rules.quote: The CAREER award, including indirect costs, is expected to total a minimum of $400,000 for the 5-year duration; Awards for proposals to BIO, ENG, or OPP are expected to total a minimum of $500,000 for the 5-year duration.

rules.title_vi: Không có cost sharing tự nguyện
rules.quote: Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.
